## Expenzo 1.0.1

Installer: `ExpenzoSetup-1.0.1.exe`

### What's new
- Release build pipeline fix: installer now carries the correct version
  (`ExpenzoSetup-1.0.1.exe`) and file metadata.

### Fixes
- Inno Setup build now receives the release version explicitly, so the
  installer name, version info, and update metadata always match.
